description:
An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) in Baltimore County, MD. Join a premier skilled nursing facility committed to providing outstanding patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. This confidential role offers a competitive annual salary.

As the LNHA, you will be instrumental in overseeing all operational aspects, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. This is a chance to lead a compassionate team and make a significant impact on the lives of residents, maintaining the facility's reputation for excellence. We are seeking a visionary leader ready to embrace this challenging yet rewarding position.
requirements: Current and valid Maryland LNHA license
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as a Nursing Home Administrator
Demonstrated leadership and operational management skills in a long-term care setting
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000 based on experience.
